performance.description: Configure client-side request optimisation for runtime queries.

runtime-query-cache-enabled.title: Runtime Query Request Cache
runtime-query-cache-enabled.description: Coalesce identical runtime queries while a request is in progress and optionally reuse successful responses for the configured time.

runtime-query-cache-ttl-ms.title: Runtime Query Cache TTL (ms)
runtime-query-cache-ttl-ms.description: Keep successful runtime query responses in memory for this many milliseconds. Use 0 to coalesce only in-progress requests.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: Control whether the app may continue from cached platform settings when the API is unreachable.

allow-working-offline.title: Allow Working Offline
allow-working-offline.description: When enabled and the API or network is unavailable, ask to continue using the last cached platform settings. When disabled, the app shows the unavailable page.

file-chooser.title: File Chooser
file-chooser.description: Platform-wide processing applied after files are chosen or dropped.

compress-images.title: Compress Images After Choose
compress-images.description: When enabled, image files are compressed before they are added to the selection.

prompt-zip-on-multiple.title: Prompt to ZIP Multiple Files
prompt-zip-on-multiple.description: When enabled, choosing multiple files at once asks whether to bundle them into a single ZIP archive.

entity.title: Entities & Lists
entity.description: Configure how entity lists, forms, and detail pages behave.

filter-apply-mode.title: Filter Apply Mode
filter-apply-mode.description: Configure the mode for applying filters.

list-persistence-mode.title: Entity List State Persistence
list-persistence-mode.description: Controls how list preferences (columns, filters, sorting, paging, expanded rows) are saved.

options.route: Save Until You Leave Current Page

show-category-columns-by-default.title: Show Category Columns by Default
show-category-columns-by-default.description: Display category columns in data grid view by default. When disabled, category columns are hidden initially.

apply-layout-ordering.title: Apply Layout Ordering
apply-layout-ordering.description: When enabled, entity form sections and properties are reordered by a standard layout (e.g. basic-info first, then classification, appearance, etc.). When disabled, layout order is left as defined by the entity.

redirect-to-details-after-create.title: Redirect to Details After Create
redirect-to-details-after-create.description: When enabled, after creating a new record the user is redirected to the entity details page. When disabled, the user stays on the list or current view. This can be overridden per action via options.process.redirect.

highlight-after-create-in-list.title: Highlight After Create in List
highlight-after-create-in-list.description: When enabled, after creating a record the new row or card is highlighted in the list.

show-page-badge.title: Show Page Badge
show-page-badge.description: When enabled, a badge indicator is displayed on the page header to show contextual information such as status or state. When disabled, the page badge is hidden.

confirm-unsaved-changes.title: Confirm Unsaved Changes
confirm-unsaved-changes.description: When enabled, a warning dialog is shown when you leave a page, close a dialog, or switch sections with unsaved edits. When disabled, changes may be lost without confirmation.

show-row-index-column.title: Show Row Index Column
show-row-index-column.description: When enabled, lists and tables that support a row number column will show it (where the view or widget also allows it). When disabled, the row index column stays hidden.

quick-search-enabled.title: Enable Quick Search
quick-search-enabled.description: When enabled, entity lists show a quick search box for fast full-text filtering. When disabled, quick search is hidden.
